sloka: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे ।वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल ॥२-२९-९॥
transliteration: lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śrutvā aham vacanam gṛhe ।vana vāsa kṛta utsāhā nityam eva mahā bala ॥2-29-9॥

translations.english: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.
